item.title: How NATO uses AI for cybersecurity and threat detection
item.description: NATO is working with OpenAI to improve cybersecurity operations, using AI for vulnerability detection and threat investigations.

item.title: NTT turns to AI to fight AI cyberattacks after blocking seven times more attacks
item.description: NTT blocked seven times more cyberattacks in October than a year earlier. CEO Akira Shimada explains how the group is using AI to find flaws first.

item.title: Elastic launches AlertZero AI workers for SoC teams
item.description: Elastic has released a preview of AlertZero, a set of AI Workers for investigating security alerts and proposing responses with supporting evidence.

item.title: Cycode expands UK teams as it seeks to turn AI into a security advantage
item.description: Cycode has established dedicated UK teams as it seeks to bolster AI development security and vulnerability remediation.

item.title: What PHP2Shell reveals about AI
item.description: PHP2Shell, two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) in PHP’s core runtime patched in October, is a case in point.

item.title: Siemens robot foundation models unpack component reels
item.description: Siemens is developing robots that unpack factory deliveries and AI agents that schedule production, with digital twins checking schedules before release.
